note: Four non-vacuous audits. The first returns WARN because feature temporal availability is undocumented in the released data; we do not claim it passes.

checks.source: Official Elliptic2 background_nodes.csv, precomputed by dataset authors
checks.time_window_documentation: The dataset release does not document whether each feature is computed over the full graph or a time window. We cannot certify temporal availability from the released files.
checks.interpretation: All 43 features are undocumented with respect to temporal availability. This is a genuine limitation: we cannot rule out that they encode future information.
Features alone predict labels well. This is expected for legitimate behavioral features and does NOT by itself prove leakage; it shows that the signal is in features, not subgraph topology.
If internal-only features drop sharply, the official aggregate features carry additional signal that may include graph-wide information beyond the subgraph.
Performance on early vs late periods shows whether the feature-label relationship is stable over real time on Real-CATS.
